**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

The Agreement's General Provisions carry New York internal law (p0145) and an exclusive New York forum — mandatory institution of suit in the City of New York with irrevocable submission to the exclusive jurisdiction of the SDNY or any New York State court, together with venue and forum non conveniens waivers (p0146). I confirmed there is no arbitration provision anywhere in the document, so no offshore seat concern arises.

This meets the preferred position (New York law plus exclusive state and federal New York courts). Two cosmetic gaps noted only in the rationale, not redlined: venue is anchored to the City of New York rather than New York County, and there is no express carve-out permitting temporary injunctive relief elsewhere (permitted but not required by the checklist).
